PORTAL: BACK TO THE START ISLAND
ACTORS: PENNED. A LANTERN HOLDS THE GHOST
PROPS: PUSH OR STEP ON THEM
PORTAL (I=10002, J=-9996) - BACK TO THE ARRIVAL POINT
GOAL-RESET (PREFIX=DEBUG, BOX=10000,-10000,10199,-9801, TO=10002,-9996) - UNDOES THE GOALS OF THIS MAP ONLY
GOAL-BELL (ID=DEBUG-BELL) - A THING BUMPED INTO IT RINGS IT, A KNOCK DOESN'T
PEN-GATE (ID=SAMPLE, I0=0, J0=0, I1=0, J1=0, COUNT=99)
GUIDE-SAGE (TEXT=SAGE: DEBUG LIES NORTH, ABOUT 50 STEPS)
SAGE: DEBUG LIES NORTH, ABOUT 50 STEPS
GUIDE-SAILOR (TEXT=SAILOR: DEBUG LIES EAST, ABOUT 50 STEPS)
SAILOR: DEBUG LIES EAST, ABOUT 50 STEPS

FARMER: DEBUG LIES SOUTH, ABOUT 50 STEPS
GUIDE-BARD (TEXT=BARD: DEBUG LIES WEST, ABOUT 50 STEPS)
BARD: DEBUG LIES WEST, ABOUT 50 STEPS
STACKS: PUSH A CHEST, THEN STEP IN TO TAKE THE PILE
PUSH BOTH: COINS AND BREAD IN ONE PILE
NESTING JARS: A JAR IN A JAR IN A JAR
PACKED BOX: TWO DOZEN THINGS INSIDE
DRAWER TOWER: PUSH IT AGAIN AND AGAIN
TOOTHPASTE ROCK: PUSH IT OVER THE WATER
YOUR STATUE: AN ECHO OPENS THE DOOR
CLOUD: PRESS IT AGAINST A WALL
PEBBLES: KICK THE ONE WITH EYES
BOOK: CATCH IT, SPELL ITS WORD
BOILED EGG: ROLL IT INTO A WALL
FLUFF: TOUCH IT, FILL THE PLOT
BLOCK FISH: FOUR IN A ROW
BAIT: X (OR THE BUTTONS) CHOOSES WHAT TO PUT. SPACE PUTS IT
PORTAL: TO THE BAIT ROOMS (THE TOOLS)
SUPPLIES. A FISH COMES BACK WHEN YOU COME BACK
APPLE: THE CHASER EATS IT, THEN SITS ON IT
FISH: THE CAT EATS IT, THEN SLEEPS ON IT
BOTH PLATES AT ONCE: WHO GETS WHICH, AND FIRST?
ANIMAL HOMES: A WARREN, A PEN, A DEN AND A HIVE
WARREN: COME CLOSE AND THEY BOLT. AN APPLE HOLDS ONE
THE SHEPHERD'S FOLD: THE GATE SHUTS ON A FULL FOLD OF THREE
FOX'S DEN: THE FOX GUARDS ITS HOARD. A FISH PUTS IT TO SLEEP
BEEHIVE: THE BEES GO OUT TO THE FLOWERS BY TURNS
GROUPS: PUZZLES RUN BY FINITE GROUPS. A LEVER SWAPS OR TURNS THE STONES IT IS TIED TO. MATCH THE MURAL
PORTAL: TO THE GROUPS (PUZZLES RUN BY FINITE GROUPS)
PORTAL: BACK TO THE DEBUG MAP
RESET: THE GROUP PUZZLES BACK AS NEW, TO PLAY AGAIN
THREE STONES. THE LEFT LEVER SWAPS THE LEFT PAIR, THE RIGHT ONE THE RIGHT PAIR. SET THEM AS THE MURAL
DEBUG: S3 (6 STATES). SOLUTION: LEFT, THEN RIGHT. RIGHT THEN LEFT IS NOT IT: THE ORDER MATTERS
FOUR STONES. EACH LEVER SWAPS THE TWO STONES EITHER SIDE OF IT. SET THEM AS THE MURAL
DEBUG: S4 (24 STATES). THE MURAL IS THE ROW REVERSED. SOLUTION: 1 2 3 1 2 1 (LEVERS LEFT TO RIGHT), 6 SWAPS
THE MOAI. THE LEVER TURNS IT A QUARTER, CLOCKWISE. TURN IT TO LOOK AS ON THE MURAL
DEBUG: Z4 (4 STATES, THE TURN HAS ORDER 4). SOLUTION: TURN TWICE
THE MOAI AGAIN. ONE LEVER TURNS IT, ONE MIRRORS IT LEFT TO RIGHT (THE RING IN ITS RIGHT EAR SHOWS WHICH). LOOK AS ON THE MURAL
DEBUG: D4 (8 STATES, R^4 = S^2 = E, SRS = R^-1). SOLUTION: MIRROR, THEN TURN. TURN THEN MIRROR LOOKS RIGHT
THE BELL RINGS WHEN THE STONES ARE BACK AS THEY BEGAN. THE SWAP: AFTER 2. THE TURN: AFTER 3. RING IT USING BOTH
DEBUG: ORDERS IN S3: SWAP 2, TURN 3, SWAP+TURN 2. SOLUTION: SWAP, TURN, SWAP, TURN
FOUR STONES, ONE DIAL: IT TURNS THEM ROUND THE SQUARE. 4 STATES. SET THEM AS THE MURAL
DEBUG: Z4: EVERY STATE IS SOME TURNS OF THE DIAL (ORDER 4). SOLUTION: DIAL TWICE
THE SAME FOUR STONES, TWO TOGGLES: LEFT FOR RIGHT, TOP FOR BOTTOM. 4 STATES TOO. SET THEM AS THE MURAL
DEBUG: Z2xZ2: EVERY LEVER AND STATE UNDOES ITSELF, NOTHING HAS ORDER 4. SOLUTION: BOTH TOGGLES, EITHER ORDER
THE WATCH PULLS A LEVER AT EACH END OF ITS WALK: THE LEFT PAIR SWAPS, AND BACK. YOURS SWAPS THE RIGHT PAIR. WHEN YOU PULL IT MATTERS
DEBUG: S3 WITH A CLOCK OF ORDER 2. SOLUTION: PULL WHILE THE LEFT PAIR IS SWAPPED, THEN WAIT ONE TICK (A B A = C B A)
PUSH A BOULDER ALONG ITS LANE: IT PULLS THE FLAT LEVERS IT ROLLS OVER, IN ORDER. A: THE LEFT PAIR, B: THE RIGHT PAIR
DEBUG: S3 IN WORDS. LANES: TOP A B, MIDDLE B A, BOTTOM B. SOLUTION: BOTTOM THEN TOP, OR MIDDLE THEN BOTTOM (B A B)
THREE ROOMS, THREE GROUPS. TWO ARE THE SAME GROUP IN DISGUISE. KNOCK ON THE PLAQUE OF THE ODD ONE OUT. HERE: TWO SWAPS
DEBUG: S3 ~= D3 (6 STATES, NOT COMMUTATIVE, ORDERS 1 2 3). Z6 COMMUTES AND ITS DIAL HAS ORDER 6. SOLUTION: THE RING'S PLAQUE
HERE: A TRIANGLE OF STONES, TURNED A THIRD, OR FLIPPED LEFT FOR RIGHT
DEBUG: S3 ~= D3 (6 STATES, NOT COMMUTATIVE, ORDERS 1 2 3). Z6 COMMUTES AND ITS DIAL HAS ORDER 6. SOLUTION: THE RING'S PLAQUE
HERE: A RING OF SIX STONES ON A DIAL, EACH PULL ONE PLACE ROUND
DEBUG: S3 ~= D3 (6 STATES, NOT COMMUTATIVE, ORDERS 1 2 3). Z6 COMMUTES AND ITS DIAL HAS ORDER 6. SOLUTION: THE RING'S PLAQUE
